# secret/db-url-password

Database URL with a password.

A connection string with an inline password (`postgres://user:pass@host`, `mongodb+srv://`, `mysql://`, `redis://:pass@`).

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: Not reported for local development: loopback hosts, and docker service names with a default password. warn for a default password on another host, and for a single-label host (a local or internal service) with any other password.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html), OWASP A07:2025.

## Why it matters

A database URL with a password is a credential: anyone who reads the file can connect to the database with the rights of that user.

## Flagged

`lib/db.ts` (block):

```ts
export const prod = postgres('postgres://app:<db-password>@db.prod.internal:5432/app');
```

`lib/db.ts` (warn):

```ts
export const weak = postgres('postgres://postgres:postgres@db.prod.internal:5432/app');
```

`lib/db.ts` (warn):

```ts
export const internal = postgres('postgres://app:<db-password>@pgbouncer:6432/app');
```

`scripts/seed.js`:

```js
const uri = 'mongodb+srv://admin:<db-password>@cluster0.q1w2e3.mongodb.net/prod?retryWrites=true';
```

`scripts/seed.js`:

```js
const mysqlUrl = 'mysql://root:<db-password>@10.0.4.12:3306/shop';
```

## Not flagged

- `DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:<db-password>@db.prod.internal:5432/app` in `.env`: .env files are covered by secret/env-file-committed
- `DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@db:5432/app` in `docker-compose.yml`: docker service with a default password
- `CACHE_URL: redis://:<db-password>@cache.example.net:6379` in `docker-compose.yml`: example host from documentation
- `command: ["sh", "-c", 'printf "postgresql://spicedb:%s@%s:%s/spicedb" "$PASS" "$HOST" "$PORT"']` in `docker-compose.yml`: printf placeholders
- `export const local = postgres('postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/app');` in `lib/db.ts`: local development database
- `export const loopback = postgres('postgres://app:<db-password>@127.0.0.1:5432/app');` in `lib/db.ts`: loopback host
- `export const ipv6 = postgres('postgresql://user:<db-password>@[2001:db8::1]:5432/app');` in `lib/db.ts`: IPv6 range reserved for documentation
- `export const template = postgres('postgresql://user:password@your-postgres-host:5432/app');` in `lib/db.ts`: placeholder host
- `export const fromEnv = postgres(process.env.DATABASE_URL!);` in `lib/db.ts`: read from the environment
- `export const interpolated = postgres('postgres://app:${process.env.DB_PASSWORD}@db.prod.internal/app');` in `lib/db.ts`: password comes from the environment

## How to fix

Read the URL from an environment variable (DATABASE_URL) and rotate the password.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore secret/db-url-password: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "secret/db-url-password": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
